title: Airborne radioactivity survey of the Edisto Island area, Berkeley, Charleston, Colleton, and Dorchester Counties, South Carolina
citation: Meuschke, J.L., 1955, Airborne radioactivity survey of the Edisto Island area, Berkeley, Charleston, Colleton, and Dorchester Counties, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Geophysical Investigations Map GP-123, map scale 1:62,500.
notes:
Airborne radioactivity survey map (1:62,500) of 322 square miles, flown April 22 to 29, 1954; scintillation equipment, traverse lines at quarter-mile spacing about 500 feet above ground (page 1). Not a geologic map; units are those the text names as sources of uraniferous phosphatic material. Abnormal radioactivity along the Atlantic Ocean beach may be due in part to thorium-bearing heavy-mineral deposits; some anomalies come from phosphate mining remnants and phosphatic highway material. Anomaly locations and intensities on the map face are illegible noise and not recorded. Page 2 is a title page only.
SUBSURFACE: none; no cross section, structure contours or logs. Base map from Corps of Engineers quadrangle sheets with contour intervals 10 and 20 feet; no vertical datum stated (page 1).
